items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: I'm talking about Fred's daddy, he was a good ball player, you see.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, real early. What, you mean the First World War? Yeah. Or before the First World War?

Well yeah, yeah, I didn't go to war until I was 26. I was 26 years old when I came back. But Jelly Roll, you see, they had a fella, he was a, I'm talking about Fred's daddy, he was a good ball player, you see. Freddie Washington?
No, Freddie Lucian. Oh Freddie Lucian.
